in_marathi.name: Hridya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Heart, Love, Affection
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hridya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hridaya means 'heart' or 'love' in Sanskrit. It is derived from the root word 'hrit' which means 'heart'. In Hindu mythology, Hridaya is the seat of emotions, feelings, and consciousness. It is also considered the abode of the Atman (soul) in the human body.
